environmentBlock.observed: Repeated primary Device Hub selection changes to an unrelated iPhone17Pro SmartInvoice preview between native actions. CUA explicitly returned user-changed and rejected the action. Guarded helpers abort on wrong device.
environmentBlock.question: Which run should have Device Hub control first?
environmentBlock.requiredBeforeDependentWork: User chooses EasyGas first and the competing Device Hub input is paused.
environmentBlock.userDecision: Finish EasyGas checks first; pause the other preview
environmentBlock.resolution: User-authorized Device Hub priority used; all 14 cases completed and GUI control released. Prior input conflict retained as history, no longer blocks this pass.
